scope: Provider documentation and public entry points, not blanket verification of card coverage, exports, pricing or rules accuracy.

providers.name: Disney Lorcana Resources
use_for: Controlling rules, tournament documents, set clarifications and event terms.
limitations: Select the current linked version and effective date; posting is not tournament eligibility.

providers.name: Official Card Gallery
use_for: Exact card/printing inspection alongside the supplied API and review ledger.
limitations: Base-set completeness does not establish all physical variants. Public API support and service limits not established.

providers.name: Disney Lorcana Companion App
use_for: Visual card catalog, collection/deck tools, lore counters and how-to-play help.
limitations: App behavior and update status require checking the installed version; no export/API contract verified. Palace Heist page advertises its special lore/draw counter.

providers.name: Ravensburger Play Hub / Carde.io
use_for: Event/store discovery; registration and organizer workflows.
limitations: Public visibility of standings, submitted decks and round results varies. Event registration is separate from read-only research. No public ingestion API contract verified.

providers.name: Ravensburger instruction servers
use_for: Gateway rules, guidebook and two deck-tip pamphlets recovered.
limitations: Read the PDF title; numeric filenames may identify a different pamphlet. Regional manual discovery remains incomplete.

providers.name: LorcanaJSON
use_for: Enriched card fields, image-derived text, external marketplace identifiers and separate Coconut downloads.
limitations: Secondary data: reconcile field conflicts against official evidence. Repository code is MIT; that does not license Disney/Ravensburger artwork. Bulk-file URLs documented but not downloaded in this pass; website access restrictions respected.

providers.name: Lorcast
use_for: Supplemental set/printing lookup and cached USD price fields.
limitations: Beta v0: plan for breaking changes. Request spacing 50–100 ms; cache at least 24 hours. Gameplay refresh weekly or after releases; provider prices daily. Do not import its legality flags as policy. Documentation describes one ink string; inspect dual-ink payloads.

providers.name: Dreamborn.ink
use_for: Deck construction/discovery and companion-app card scanning into collections.
limitations: Deck popularity is not measured strength. No documented public API contract verified; use intentional exports or public list pages. Existing personal CSV remains authoritative for its export date.

providers.name: InkDecks
use_for: Tournament deck discovery and event-specific metagame/winrate pages.
limitations: Check registered field, published lists and paired results separately; coverage varies by event. API/access limits not verified. Color-pair share need not describe the full field.

providers.name: LorcanaHunter
use_for: Discover events, list transcriptions and upstream tournament links.
limitations: Homepage displayed an October 5 update despite the October 4 workspace date; do not use that timestamp or summary as a date-qualified dataset. Color order may duplicate pairs. Verify per-event provenance and denominators.

providers.name: Elorcana
use_for: Player result history and tournament discovery.
limitations: Fan Elo is a provider model, not official ranking or deck strength. Its published scope selects major/qualified events rather than all local play.

providers.name: Lore Guide Institute
use_for: Structured rules, teaching and enforcement practice.
limitations: Independent community education; badges are its records, not official certification. Official PDFs control adjudication.

providers.name: TCGCSV
use_for: Daily TCGplayer-derived product/price observations and archives from February 8, 2024.
limitations: Provider update target 20:00 UTC; record actual payload update time. Join products/prices by productId and keep subTypeName. No condition/language SKU data or individual sold/listed transactions. Public files are separate from TCGplayer API authorization.

providers.name: TCGplayer
use_for: Regional listing inspection; existing authorized integrations follow provider terms.
limitations: Getting-started docs say new API access is not granted. September 2026 seller API program update does not establish open new developer access. Do not design a dependency around obtaining a new key.

providers.name: Cardmarket
use_for: Regional public price guide and catalog with native product IDs.
limitations: Public download availability documented; direct download access not verified here. API applications closed. January 2026 API base moved to apiv2.cardmarket.com for existing users. Catalog/price aggregates are not condition-specific purchase quotes.

providers.name: CardTrader
use_for: Blueprint/product distinction, expansion catalog and marketplace listings.
limitations: Bearer token required; no account or credential configured. Marketplace documentation contains both 1-call/second cache guidance and a 10-request/second limit: use the conservative 1/second pending clarification. Purchasing endpoints require separate explicit user instructions.

providers.name: Ink Table
use_for: Fan solo practice against heuristic AI.
limitations: Provider describes short-horizon heuristic decisions. Current Set 14 coverage and interaction correctness not tested; games here do not measure human tournament matchups.

providers.name: TCG Online (formerly Lorcanito)
use_for: Community online games, rooms and replay discovery.
limitations: Provider announces Lorcanito migration July 23, 2026. Unofficial engine: check current implementation, queue format and match structure; homepage default Infinity best-of-one is not Core evidence. No gameplay sessions run in this pass.
